name: body-arms
prompt:
Create a professional CUTOUT PUPPET PARTS atlas for the exact gothic PALADIN in reference1. These are revised production pieces for a hero displayed only100pixels tall. Match the PAINTED reference1 bulky stocky proportions, NOT a slender realistic knight. HUGE broad chunky armor masses; stout thick limbs, oversized head and pauldrons, broad short chest, wide heavy boots. Very thick charcoal BLACK outlines roughly8-12pixels at a512px part, 2-3TIMES normal illustration outline, broad flat bone highlights and dusty lilac shadows, wine red cloth. NO fine hatching, microtextures, thin engraved detail or stacks of riblike armor scales. Each limb has ONLY TWO or THREE large smooth plates, bold simple readable silhouette, angular gothic grotesque, coarse pixel edges. Bone219194166, burgundy871842, charcoal191722. No gradients, blur, glow, labels, letters, layout borders, castshadows. True alpha0 transparent background.
EXACT4columns x2rows, eight separated isolated objects, one percell, requested2048x1024,512squarecells. Keep everypiece inside itscell with10%padding. Same3quarterRIGHT view, neutral arms down. Reconstruct hidden rounded shoulder/elbow/hip/knee/neck joint material with generous SOLID overlap; no cutout holes or missing surfaces. Separate parts, NOT a wholeassembled character. Rounded joint caps tucked under armor. This is complete painted geometry for rigging, not cropped visible scraps.
Reference2 is ONLY the SHIELD design: preserve its exact shape, proportions, winefill, boneedge and cross; only make black outer/inner contour thicker. ROW1 lefttoright: 1 LARGE broad faceted visor helmet HEAD with short thick fullyfilled neckstub below, no shoulders. 2 TORSO chest: SHORT BROAD barrel breastplate, wine scarf, bone cross on short wine tabard down to waist, chunky sideplates, filled hidden shoulder attachments and rounded belly overlap; NO pauldrons arms belt. Chest WIDTH similar toHEIGHT, NOT long narrow triangle. 3 PELVIS: stout wide belt and hiparmor, SHORT dense lower wine tabard with just2-3broad tips, no legs; solid rounded waist overlap, not long hanging skirt. 4 SHIELD copied fromreference2 with heavier contour, no hand.
ROW2: 1 FRONT UPPERARM (viewerleft macearm): huge broad angular pauldron and SHORT thick upperarm ending solid rounded elbowcap, only2large armorplates; noforearm. 2 FRONT FOREARM including hand, one SHORT WIDE solid angular gauntlet mass and massive closed gripping fist, rounded elbowcap, NOT thin wrist and separate tinyfingerplates, no weapon. 3 BACK UPPERARM (viewerright shieldarm): matching farpauldron and shortthick upperarm,2largeplates, rounded hidden shoulder/elbow, noforearm. 4 BACK FOREARM withhand: same stout singlemass gauntlet, fullypainted behindshield, no shield/weapon. All limbs stout with width about60-80% theirlength, no thin noodlearms. Matchreference1.
